general.ayuda_1: Choose a pool to view its documents. You can search the pool formation record by text.
general.ayuda_2: “View receipt” shows the retained record details. Download the receipt if you need a copy.
general.sin_bolsas: There are no pools available to view.
general.vacio: There are no documents matching these filters. Change the search or clear the filters.
general.denegado: You do not have permission to view these documents. Contact your manager.
general.bolsa_no_disponible: There is no pool formation record available for this pool. Choose another pool.
general.error_consulta: The documents could not be loaded. Check your connection and select Try again.
general.error_recibo: The receipt could not be opened. Select Try again.
general.error_descarga: The receipt could not be downloaded. Please try again.
